staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Token length field definition
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Token Length field MUST be a variable-length integer specifying the length of the Token field, in bytes.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Token length when absent
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Token Length field MUST be 0 if no token is present.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Token field value source
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Token field MUST carry the value that was previously provided in a Retry packet or NEW_TOKEN frame.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Initial packet type selection
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A client or server MUST use the Initial packet type for any packet that contains an initial cryptographic handshake message.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Respond to a client Initial with the first server Initial
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A server MUST send its first Initial packet in response to a client Initial.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Include handshake or ACK material in Initial payloads
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The payload of an Initial packet MUST include a CRYPTO frame or frames containing a cryptographic handshake message, ACK frames, or both.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Handling Initial packets with other frames
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint that receives an Initial packet containing other frames MAY discard the packet as spurious or treat it as a connection error.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Include CRYPTO data in the client's first packet
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The first packet sent by a client MUST always include a CRYPTO frame that contains the start or all of the first cryptographic handshake message.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Start the first CRYPTO frame at offset 0
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The first CRYPTO frame sent MUST begin at an offset of 0.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Align later Initial CRYPTO offsets with first-flight size
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: These Initial packets MUST contain CRYPTO frames starting at an offset matching the size of the CRYPTO frames sent in the first flight of Initial packets.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Continue the cryptographic handshake in later Initial packets
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: These Initial packets MUST continue the cryptographic handshake.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Stop client Initial processing after sending the first Handshake packet
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A client MUST stop both sending and processing Initial packets when it sends its first Handshake packet.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Stop server Initial processing after receiving the first Handshake packet
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A server MUST stop both sending and processing Initial packets when it receives its first Handshake packet.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Discard initial packet protection keys
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Initial packet protection keys MUST be discarded.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Discard recovery and congestion state
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Any loss recovery and congestion control state MUST be discarded.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Include reserved bits in the first byte
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The first byte of a 0-RTT packet MUST contain the Reserved and Packet Number Length bits.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use long headers for 0-RTT packets
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A 0-RTT packet MUST use long headers with type value 0x01, followed by the Length and Packet Number fields.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Accept or reject 0-RTT early data
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The server MAY accept or reject 0-RTT early data during the TLS handshake.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define the 0-RTT packet header layout
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A 0-RTT packet header MUST have Header Form (1) = 1, Fixed Bit (1) = 1, Long Packet Type (2) = 1, Reserved Bits (2), Packet Number Length (2), Version (32), Destination Connection ID Length (8), Destination Connection ID (0..160), Source Connection ID Length (8), Source Connection ID (0..160), Length (i), Packet Number (8..32), and Packet Payload (8..).

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Share packet number space with 1-RTT
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Packet numbers for 0-RTT protected packets MUST use the same space as 1-RTT protected packets.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use new packet numbers for new packets
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: New packet numbers MUST be used for any new packets that are sent.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Delay 0-RTT acknowledgments until handshake completion
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A client MUST NOT receive acknowledgments for its 0-RTT packets until the handshake is complete.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Forbid ACK frames in 0-RTT packets
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A client MUST NOT send an ACK frame in a 0-RTT packet.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Place reserved and packet-number-length bits in the first byte
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The first byte of a Handshake packet MUST contain the Reserved and Packet Number Length bits.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use long headers and packet type 0x02
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A Handshake packet MUST use long headers with a type value of 0x02, followed by the Length and Packet Number fields.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define the Handshake packet wire format
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A Handshake packet MUST have Header Form set to 1, Fixed Bit set to 1, Long Packet Type set to 2, Reserved Bits, Packet Number Length, Version, Destination Connection ID Length, Destination Connection ID, Source Connection ID Length, Source Connection ID, Length, Packet Number, and Packet Payload fields in that order.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Populate the Destination Connection ID from the recipient
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Destination Connection ID field in a Handshake packet MUST contain a connection ID chosen by the recipient of the packet.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Populate the Source Connection ID from the sender
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Source Connection ID field in a Handshake packet MUST include the connection ID that the sender of the packet wishes to use.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Discard Handshake CRYPTO data when handshake keys are discarded
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: When Handshake protection keys are discarded, data in CRYPTO frames for Handshake packets MUST be discarded.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Stop retransmitting Handshake CRYPTO data when handshake keys are discarded
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: When Handshake protection keys are discarded, retransmission of data in CRYPTO frames for Handshake packets MUST stop.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use the Retry packet long header type
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A Retry packet MUST use a long packet header with type value of 0x03.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Carry a server-created address validation token in Retry packets
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A Retry packet MUST carry an address validation token created by the server.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Include the Retry packet unused field
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A Retry packet MUST include a 4-bit Unused field.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Lay out the remaining Retry packet fields in order
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A Retry packet MUST include, in order, Version (32), Destination Connection ID Length (8), Destination Connection ID (0..160), Source Connection ID Length (8), Source Connection ID (0..160), Retry Token, and Retry Integrity Tag (128).

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Retry packets contain no protected fields
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A Retry packet MUST contain no protected fields.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Allow arbitrary Retry packet unused bits
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A server MAY set the Unused field to any value.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Ignore Retry packet unused bits
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A client MUST ignore the bits in the Unused field.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Set Retry DCID from the client's Initial SCID
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The server MUST set the Retry packet's Destination Connection ID to the client's Initial packet Source Connection ID.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Set Retry SCID to a server-chosen ID
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The server MUST set the Retry packet's Source Connection ID to a server-chosen connection ID.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Require Retry SCID to differ from the client's DCID
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Retry packet's Source Connection ID MUST NOT equal the Destination Connection ID field of the packet sent by the client.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Discard Retry packets that reuse the Initial DCID
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A client MUST discard a Retry packet whose Source Connection ID equals the Destination Connection ID field of its Initial packet.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use Retry SCID as later DCID
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The client MUST use the Retry packet's Source Connection ID as the Destination Connection ID field of subsequent packets it sends.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Discard unvalidated Retry packets
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Clients MUST discard Retry packets that have a Retry Integrity Tag that cannot be validated.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Respond to Retry with Initial
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A client MUST respond to a Retry packet with an Initial packet that includes the provided Retry token.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Copy Retry source CID into Initial destination CID
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A client MUST set the Destination Connection ID field of the Initial packet to the Retry packet's Source Connection ID field.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Change Initial keys when Destination Connection ID changes
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Changing the Destination Connection ID field MUST change the keys used to protect the Initial packet.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Set Initial token from Retry packet
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A client MUST set the Token field to the token provided in the Retry packet.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Preserve source CID on Retry response
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The client MUST NOT change the Source Connection ID.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Retry packets cannot be explicitly acknowledged
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A client MUST NOT explicitly acknowledge a Retry packet.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Retry packets have no packet number
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A Retry packet MUST NOT include a packet number.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Copy Retry Source Connection ID into Destination Connection ID
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The client MUST copy the Source Connection ID field from the Retry packet to the Destination Connection ID field and continue using that value until an Initial packet with an updated value is received.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Copy Retry token to subsequent Initial packets
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The client MUST copy the Token field from the Retry packet to all subsequent Initial packets.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Keep first-Initial restrictions after Retry
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Other than updating the Destination Connection ID and Token fields, the client MUST subject the Initial packet sent after Retry to the same restrictions as the first Initial packet.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Preserve 0-RTT protection keys after Retry
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The keys used to protect these new 0-RTT packets MUST NOT change as a result of responding to a Retry packet.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Copy connection IDs into transport parameters
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The connection IDs used in Initial and Retry packets exchanged between client and server MUST be copied to the transport parameters.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Validate connection IDs per Section 7.3
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The connection IDs used in Initial and Retry packets exchanged between client and server MUST be validated as described in Section 7.3.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Single short-header packet type
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: QUIC MUST define a single packet type that uses the short packet header.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Include destination connection ID field
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A 1-RTT packet MUST include a destination connection ID field of 0 to 160 bits.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Include key phase bit
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A 1-RTT packet MUST include a key phase bit.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Include packet number field
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A 1-RTT packet MUST include a packet number field of 8 to 32 bits.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Include packet number length field
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A 1-RTT packet MUST include a packet number length field of 2 bits.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Include packet payload
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A 1-RTT packet MUST include a packet payload of at least 8 bits.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Include reserved bits
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A 1-RTT packet MUST include 2 reserved bits.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Include spin bit
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A 1-RTT packet MUST include a spin bit.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Set header form bit to 0
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The most significant bit (0x80) of byte 0 in the short header MUST be 0.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Set fixed bit to 1
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The next bit (0x40) of byte 0 in the short header MUST be 1.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Discard packets with zero fixed bit
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Packets containing a zero value for this bit are not valid packets in this version and MUST be discarded.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define the spin bit in byte 0
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The third most significant bit (0x20) of byte 0 MUST be the latency spin bit, set as described in Section 17.4.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Zero reserved bits before protection
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The value included prior to protection MUST be set to 0.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Indicate key phase in byte 0
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The next bit (0x04) of byte 0 MUST indicate the key phase.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Protect packet number length bits with header protection
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The least significant two bits (those with a mask of 0x03) of byte 0 MUST be protected using header protection.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Destination Connection ID chosen by recipient
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The intended recipient of a packet MUST choose the Destination Connection ID.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Packet Number field length
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Packet Number field MUST be 1 to 4 bytes long.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Packet number protected with header protection
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Packet Number field MUST be protected using header protection.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Packet Number Length encodes packet number length
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Packet Number Length field MUST encode the length of the Packet Number field.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: 1-RTT packets include protected payload
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: 1-RTT packets MUST include a 1-RTT protected payload.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Short header header form bit and DCID are version-independent
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The header form bit and the Destination Connection ID field of a short header packet MUST be interpreted independently of QUIC version.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Short header remaining fields are version-specific
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The remaining fields of a short header packet MUST be specific to the selected QUIC version.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Spin bit only in 1-RTT packets
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The spin bit MUST only be present in 1-RTT packets.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Spin bit is optional
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Implementations MAY support the spin bit.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Disable unsupported spin bit
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint that does not support the spin bit MUST disable it.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Endpoint decides spin bit state independently
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Each endpoint MUST decide independently whether the spin bit is enabled or disabled for a connection.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Random spin-bit disablement floor
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Even when the spin bit is not disabled by the administrator, endpoints MUST disable their use of the spin bit for a random selection of at least one in every 16 network paths or one in every 16 connection IDs.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Randomize disabled spin bit value
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Endpoints SHOULD set the spin bit to a random value either chosen independently for each packet or chosen independently for each connection ID.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Maintain per-path spin values
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: If the spin bit is enabled for the connection, the endpoint MUST maintain a spin value for each network path.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Set spin bit from stored path value
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: If the spin bit is enabled for the connection, the endpoint MUST set the spin bit in the packet header to the currently stored value when it sends a 1-RTT packet on that path.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Initialize spin value to zero
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST initialize the spin value to 0 for each network path.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Track highest peer packet number per path
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Each endpoint MUST remember the highest packet number seen from its peer on each path.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Update server spin value on new client packet
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: When a server receives a 1-RTT packet that increases the highest packet number seen by the server from the client on a given network path, it MUST set the spin value for that path equal to the spin bit in the received packet.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Reset spin value when connection ID changes
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST reset the spin value for a network path to 0 when it changes the connection ID being used on that network path.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Encode transport parameters as a sequence
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The QUIC transport parameters MUST be encoded as a sequence of transport parameters.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Encode transport parameters as tuples
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Each transport parameter MUST be encoded as an (identifier, length, value) tuple.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Include transport parameter bytes in handshake
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: QUIC MUST encode transport parameters into a sequence of bytes that is included in the cryptographic handshake.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Reserve 31 * N + 27 transport parameter identifiers
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Transport parameters with an identifier of the form "31 * N + 27" for integer values of N MUST be reserved.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Integer transport parameters use variable-length integer encoding
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Integer transport parameters MUST use variable-length integer encoding.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Absent transport parameters default to zero
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An absent transport parameter MUST default to 0 unless otherwise stated.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: original_destination_connection_id comes from the first client Initial
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The original_destination_connection_id transport parameter MUST equal the Destination Connection ID from the client's first Initial packet.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: original_destination_connection_id is server-only
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The original_destination_connection_id transport parameter MUST be sent only by a server.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: max_idle_timeout is encoded as an integer in milliseconds
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The max_idle_timeout transport parameter MUST be encoded as an integer number of milliseconds.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Disable idle timeout when both endpoints omit it or set it to zero
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Idle timeout MUST be disabled when both endpoints omit max_idle_timeout or set it to 0.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: stateless_reset_token is 16 bytes
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The stateless_reset_token transport parameter MUST be a 16-byte sequence.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: stateless_reset_token is used to verify stateless reset
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The stateless_reset_token transport parameter MUST be used to verify stateless reset.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Clients must not send stateless_reset_token
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A client MUST NOT send the stateless_reset_token transport parameter.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Servers may send stateless_reset_token
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A server MAY send the stateless_reset_token transport parameter.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Servers that omit stateless_reset_token cannot use stateless reset
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A server that does not send stateless_reset_token MUST NOT use stateless reset for the connection ID negotiated during the handshake.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: max_udp_payload_size limits received UDP payload size
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The max_udp_payload_size transport parameter MUST be an integer limit on UDP payload size the endpoint is willing to receive.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Default max UDP payload size
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The default for max_udp_payload_size MUST be 65527 bytes.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Maximum UDP payload size floor
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The max_udp_payload_size transport parameter value MUST be at least 1200 bytes.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Constrain datagram size with max_udp_payload_size
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The max_udp_payload_size limit MUST constrain datagram size and be an endpoint property, not a path property.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define initial_max_data transport parameter
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The initial_max_data transport parameter MUST specify the initial maximum amount of data that can be sent on the connection.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Treat the limit as MAX_DATA after handshake
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The initial_max_data limit MUST be treated as equivalent to sending MAX_DATA immediately after the handshake completes.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define initial_max_stream_data_bidi_local
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The initial_max_stream_data_bidi_local parameter MUST specify the initial flow-control limit for bidirectional streams opened by the endpoint that sends the transport parameter; for client transport parameters, this applies to stream IDs with low bits 0x00, and for server transport parameters, to stream IDs with low bits 0x01.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define initial_max_stream_data_bidi_remote
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The initial_max_stream_data_bidi_remote parameter MUST specify the initial flow-control limit for bidirectional streams opened by the endpoint that receives the transport parameter; for client transport parameters, this applies to stream IDs with low bits 0x01, and for server transport parameters, to stream IDs with low bits 0x00.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define initial_max_stream_data_uni
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The initial_max_stream_data_uni parameter MUST specify the initial flow control limit for unidirectional streams.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Apply initial_max_stream_data_uni to newly created unidirectional streams
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The limit specified by initial_max_stream_data_uni MUST apply to newly created unidirectional streams opened by the endpoint that receives the transport parameter.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Scope initial_max_stream_data_uni to client transport parameters
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: In client transport parameters, initial_max_stream_data_uni MUST apply to streams whose identifier has the least significant two bits set to 0x03.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Scope initial_max_stream_data_uni to server transport parameters
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: In server transport parameters, initial_max_stream_data_uni MUST apply to streams whose identifier has the least significant two bits set to 0x02.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define initial_max_streams_bidi semantics
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The initial_max_streams_bidi transport parameter MUST contain the initial maximum number of bidirectional streams the receiving endpoint is permitted to initiate.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Block bidirectional streams when limit is absent
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: If initial_max_streams_bidi is absent or zero, the peer MUST remain unable to open bidirectional streams until a MAX_STREAMS frame is sent.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define initial_max_streams_uni semantics
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The initial_max_streams_uni transport parameter MUST contain the initial maximum number of unidirectional streams the receiving endpoint is permitted to initiate.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Block unidirectional streams when limit is absent
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: If initial_max_streams_uni is absent or zero, the peer MUST remain unable to open unidirectional streams until a MAX_STREAMS frame is sent.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define ack_delay_exponent semantics
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The ack_delay_exponent transport parameter MUST indicate an exponent used to decode the ACK Delay field in the ACK frame (Section 19.3).

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Default ack_delay_exponent to 3 when absent
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: If ack_delay_exponent is absent, the receiver MUST assume a default value of 3.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Reject ack_delay_exponent values above 20
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Values above 20 MUST be treated as invalid.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define max_ack_delay semantics
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The max_ack_delay transport parameter MUST indicate the maximum amount of time in milliseconds by which the endpoint will delay sending acknowledgments.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Include expected alarm delays in max_ack_delay
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The max_ack_delay value SHOULD include the receiver's expected delays in alarms firing.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Default max_ack_delay to 25 ms when absent
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: If max_ack_delay is absent, the endpoint MUST assume a default of 25 milliseconds.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Reject max_ack_delay values at or above 2^14
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Values of 2^14 or greater MUST be treated as invalid.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Advertise disable_active_migration when active migration is unsupported
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The disable_active_migration transport parameter MUST be included if the endpoint does not support active connection migration (Section 9) on the address being used during the handshake.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Prevent new local addresses after disable_active_migration
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint that receives this transport parameter MUST keep using the local address it used during the handshake when sending to the peer's handshake address.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Preferred address does not prohibit migration
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: This transport parameter MUST allow connection migration after a client has acted on a preferred_address transport parameter.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Preferred address parameter is zero length
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: This parameter MUST be a zero-length value.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Preferred address is server-sent only
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The preferred_address transport parameter MUST only be sent by a server.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: IPv4 address precedes IPv4 port
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The four-byte IPv4 Address field MUST be followed by the associated two-byte IPv4 Port field.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: IPv6 address precedes IPv6 port
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The 16-byte IPv6 Address field MUST be followed by the two-byte IPv6 Port field.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Connection ID length describes following field
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: After address and port pairs, a Connection ID Length field MUST describe the length of the following Connection ID field.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Preferred address fields use sequence number 1
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Connection ID field and the Stateless Reset Token field of a preferred address MUST contain an alternative connection ID that has a sequence number of 1.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Preferred address fields match NEW_CONNECTION_ID syntax and semantics
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Connection ID and Stateless Reset Token fields of a preferred address MUST be identical in syntax and semantics to the corresponding fields of a NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Preferred addresses must not carry zero-length connection IDs
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A server MUST NOT include a zero-length connection ID in this transport parameter.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Suppress NEW_CONNECTION_ID frames when using zero-length connection IDs
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: If an endpoint issues a zero-length connection ID, it MUST never send a NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Map initial stream data limits to MAX_STREAM_DATA
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: If present, the initial_max_stream_data_bidi_local, initial_max_stream_data_bidi_remote, and initial_max_stream_data_uni transport parameters MUST be equivalent to sending a MAX_STREAM_DATA frame on every stream of the corresponding type immediately after opening.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Default initial stream data limits to 0 when absent
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: If the initial_max_stream_data_bidi_local, initial_max_stream_data_bidi_remote, or initial_max_stream_data_uni transport parameter is absent, streams of the corresponding type MUST start with a flow control limit of 0.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Treat forbidden server-only transport parameters as errors
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A server MUST treat receipt of original_destination_connection_id, preferred_address, retry_source_connection_id, or stateless_reset_token as a connection error of type TRANSPORT_PARAMETER_ERROR.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use PADDING frames to enlarge packets
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MAY use PADDING frames to increase the size of a packet.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use PADDING frames for Initial packet sizing
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MAY use PADDING frames to increase an Initial packet to the minimum required size.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use PADDING frames for traffic-analysis protection
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MAY use PADDING frames to provide protection against traffic analysis for protected packets.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: PADDING frame is a single-byte encoding
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A PADDING frame MUST consist of the single byte that identifies the frame as a PADDING frame.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: PADDING frame type value
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The PADDING frame type MUST be 0x00.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: PING frame type value
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The PING frame type MUST be 0x01.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Acknowledge packets containing PING frames
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A receiver of a PING frame MUST acknowledge the packet containing the PING frame.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: ACK frames carry ACK Ranges
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An ACK frame MUST contain one or more ACK Ranges.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: ACK Ranges identify acknowledged packets
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: ACK Ranges MUST identify acknowledged packets.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: ACK frames with ECN report cumulative marks
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: If the frame type is 0x03, an ACK frame MUST also contain the cumulative count of QUIC packets with associated ECN marks received on the connection up until this point.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Properly handle both ACK frame types
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: QUIC implementations MUST properly handle both ACK frame types.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use ECN information to manage congestion state
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: If ECN is enabled for packets they send, QUIC implementations SHOULD use the information in the ECN section to manage their congestion state.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Retain acknowledged packets
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A packet MUST remain acknowledged once it has been acknowledged, even if it does not appear in a future ACK frame.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: ACK frames stay within a packet number space
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Each ACK frame MUST only acknowledge packet numbers in the same space as the packet in which the ACK frame is contained.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: VN and Retry packets are implicitly acknowledged
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Version Negotiation and Retry packets MUST be implicitly acknowledged by the next Initial packet sent by the client.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: ACK frame ECN counts are optional
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An ACK frame MAY include ECN Counts.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: ACK frame field order
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: After the Type field, an ACK frame MUST encode Largest Acknowledged, ACK Delay, ACK Range Count, First ACK Range, and ACK Range in that order.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: ACK frame type values
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Type field in an ACK frame MUST be 0x02 or 0x03.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Largest Acknowledged field meaning
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Largest Acknowledged MUST be a variable-length integer representing the largest packet number the peer is acknowledging.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: ACK frame values are not truncated
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Largest Acknowledged field in an ACK frame MUST NOT be truncated.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Decode ACK delay with exponent scaling
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An ACK Delay value MUST be decoded by multiplying the field value by 2 to the power of the ack_delay_exponent transport parameter sent by the sender of the ACK frame.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Encode ACK delay as a varint
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The ACK Delay field MUST be a variable-length integer encoding the acknowledgment delay in microseconds.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define ACK Range Count as a varint
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The ACK Range Count field MUST be a variable-length integer specifying the number of ACK Range fields in the frame.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define the first ACK range as a varint
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The First ACK Range field MUST be a variable-length integer indicating the number of contiguous packets preceding the Largest Acknowledged that are being acknowledged.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Derive the smallest acknowledged packet from the first range
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The smallest packet acknowledged in the range MUST be determined by subtracting the First ACK Range value from the Largest Acknowledged field.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Alternate gaps and ACK ranges
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The ACK Ranges field MUST contain additional ranges of packets that are alternately not acknowledged (Gap) and acknowledged (ACK Range).

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Bind range element counts to ACK Range Count
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The ACK Range Count field MUST determine the number of Gap and ACK Range Length values, with one of each present for each ACK Range Count value.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define Gap as a varint
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Gap field MUST be a variable-length integer indicating the number of contiguous unacknowledged packets preceding the packet number one lower than the smallest in the preceding ACK Range.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define ACK Range Length as a varint
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The ACK Range Length field MUST be a variable-length integer indicating the number of contiguous acknowledged packets preceding the largest packet number, as determined by the preceding Gap.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use relative integer encoding for ACK range values
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Gap and ACK Range Length values MUST use relative integer encoding.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: ACK ranges encode preceding packets
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Each ACK Range MUST encode the number of acknowledged packets that precede the largest packet number in that range.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Map larger ACK range values to larger packet ranges
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Larger ACK Range values MUST indicate larger ranges with lower smallest packet numbers.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Compute smallest ACK range value from the largest
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Given a largest packet number for the range, the smallest value MUST equal largest - ack_range.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Treat ACK ranges as inclusive packet intervals
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An ACK Range MUST acknowledge all packets between the smallest packet number and the largest, inclusive.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Derive each ACK range largest value from prior gaps and lengths
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The largest value for an ACK Range MUST be computed by cumulatively subtracting preceding ACK Range Lengths and Gaps.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Encode gap length as one less than the packet count
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The number of packets in the gap MUST be one higher than the encoded value of the Gap field.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Stop STREAM transmission after RESET_STREAM
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: After sending a RESET_STREAM, an endpoint MUST cease transmission and retransmission of STREAM frames on the identified stream.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Discard received data after RESET_STREAM
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A receiver of RESET_STREAM MAY discard any data it already received on that stream.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: RESET_STREAM frame format
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A RESET_STREAM frame MUST encode Type as 0x04 and include Stream ID, Application Protocol Error Code, and Final Size in that order.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Encode RESET_STREAM stream ID
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Stream ID field of a RESET_STREAM frame MUST be a variable-length integer encoding of the stream ID of the stream being terminated.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Recover Initial packet keys at the receiving entity
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An entity that receives an Initial packet from a client MUST be able to recover the keys needed to read the packet and generate Initial packets authenticated at either endpoint.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Protect non-Initial packets with handshake keys
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: All other packets MUST be protected with keys derived from the cryptographic handshake.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Limit packet keys to the communicating endpoints
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The cryptographic handshake MUST ensure that only the communicating endpoints receive the corresponding keys for Handshake, 0-RTT, and 1-RTT packets.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Apply header-protection confidentiality to packet numbers
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Packet Number field that appears in some packet types MUST have alternative confidentiality protection applied as part of header protection.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Increase packet numbers within a packet number space
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The underlying packet number MUST increase with each packet sent in a given packet number space.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Encode RESET_STREAM application error code
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Application Protocol Error Code field of a RESET_STREAM frame MUST be a variable-length integer containing the application protocol error code that indicates why the stream is being closed.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Encode RESET_STREAM final size
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Final Size field of a RESET_STREAM frame MUST be a variable-length integer indicating the final size of the stream by the RESET_STREAM sender, in units of bytes.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use STOP_SENDING to signal discarded incoming data
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST use STOP_SENDING to signal that incoming data is being discarded on receipt per application request.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: STOP_SENDING requests transmission stop
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A STOP_SENDING frame MUST request that a peer stop transmitting on a stream.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Allow STOP_SENDING on Recv or Size Known streams
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A STOP_SENDING frame MAY be sent for streams in the Recv or Size Known states.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Encode STOP_SENDING payload fields in order
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A STOP_SENDING frame MUST encode Stream ID (i) followed by Application Protocol Error Code (i).

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Set STOP_SENDING frame type to 0x05
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A STOP_SENDING frame MUST have type 0x05.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define STOP_SENDING Stream ID field
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The STOP_SENDING Stream ID field MUST be a variable-length integer carrying the stream ID of the stream being ignored.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Make Length cover packet number and payload fields
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Length field MUST include both the Packet Number and Payload fields, both of which are confidentiality protected and initially of unknown length.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Learn payload length after header protection removal
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The length of the Payload field MUST be learned once header protection is removed.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Allow packet coalescing using the Length field
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A sender MAY coalesce multiple QUIC packets into one UDP datagram using the Length field.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define STOP_SENDING application error code field
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The STOP_SENDING Application Protocol Error Code field MUST be a variable-length integer containing the application-specified reason the sender is ignoring the stream.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Prohibit CRYPTO frames in 0-RTT packets
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A CRYPTO frame MUST NOT be sent in 0-RTT packets.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Provide an in-order byte stream with CRYPTO frames
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The CRYPTO frame MUST provide the cryptographic protocol with an in-order stream of bytes.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Exclude flow control from CRYPTO frames
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A CRYPTO frame MUST NOT be flow controlled.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Omit end-of-stream marker from CRYPTO frames
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A CRYPTO frame MUST NOT carry the end-of-stream marker.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Omit optional length marker from CRYPTO frames
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A CRYPTO frame MUST NOT carry the optional length marker.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Omit optional offset marker from CRYPTO frames
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A CRYPTO frame MUST NOT carry the optional offset marker.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Omit stream identifier from CRYPTO frames
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A CRYPTO frame MUST NOT bear a stream identifier.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Encode CRYPTO fields in order
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A CRYPTO frame MUST encode Offset (i), Length (i), and Crypto Data (..) in that order.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Set CRYPTO frame type to 0x06
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A CRYPTO frame MUST have type 0x06.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: CRYPTO Offset field
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Offset field MUST specify the byte offset in the stream for the data in this CRYPTO frame.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: CRYPTO Length field
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Length field MUST specify the length of the Crypto Data field in this CRYPTO frame.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: CRYPTO flow starts at offset 0
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Each encryption level's cryptographic handshake data MUST start at an offset of 0.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Separate CRYPTO flows per encryption level
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: There MUST be a separate flow of cryptographic handshake data in each encryption level.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: CRYPTO stream offset limit
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The largest offset delivered on a stream -- the sum of the offset and data length -- MUST NOT exceed 2^62-1.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: CRYPTO frames have no FIN bit
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: CRYPTO frames MUST NOT have a FIN bit.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: NEW_TOKEN Token field order
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A NEW_TOKEN frame MUST encode a Token field after the Token Length field.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: NEW_TOKEN Token Length field encoding
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A NEW_TOKEN frame MUST encode a Token Length field as a variable-length integer.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: NEW_TOKEN Type field value
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A NEW_TOKEN frame MUST encode a Type field with value 0x07.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define the Token Length field semantics
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Token Length field MUST be a variable-length integer that specifies the token length in bytes.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Have STREAM frames carry stream data
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: STREAM frames MUST carry stream data.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Have STREAM frames implicitly create streams
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: STREAM frames MUST implicitly create a stream.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Constrain STREAM frame type values
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The STREAM frame Type field MUST take the form 0b00001XXX (or the set of values from 0x08 to 0x0f).

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Map STREAM type low-order bits to present fields
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The three low-order bits of the STREAM frame Type field MUST determine which fields are present in the frame.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Include Offset field when OFF bit is set
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A STREAM frame with the OFF bit set MUST include an Offset field.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Omit Offset field when OFF bit is clear
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A STREAM frame with the OFF bit clear MUST omit the Offset field.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Start stream data at offset 0 when OFF bit is clear
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A STREAM frame with the OFF bit clear MUST start Stream Data at offset 0.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Include Length field when LEN bit is set
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A STREAM frame with the LEN bit set MUST include a Length field.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Extend Stream Data to end of packet when LEN bit is clear
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A STREAM frame with the LEN bit clear MUST extend Stream Data to the end of the packet.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Omit Length field when LEN bit is clear
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A STREAM frame with the LEN bit clear MUST omit the Length field.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Mark end of stream with FIN bit
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A STREAM frame with the FIN bit set MUST mark the end of the stream.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Compute final stream size from offset and length
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The final size of the stream MUST equal the sum of the offset and the length of the frame.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: STREAM frame Stream ID encoding
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Stream ID field in a STREAM frame MUST be a variable-length integer.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: STREAM frame Offset encoding
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Offset field in a STREAM frame MUST be a variable-length integer specifying the byte offset in the stream for the data in this STREAM frame.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: STREAM frame Length encoding
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Length field in a STREAM frame MUST be a variable-length integer specifying the length of the Stream Data field in this STREAM frame.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: STREAM frame Stream Data payload
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Stream Data field in a STREAM frame MUST contain bytes from the designated stream to be delivered.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use zero-length STREAM data to indicate the next byte offset
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: When a Stream Data field has a length of 0, the STREAM frame offset MUST be the offset of the next byte that would be sent.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Assign offset zero to the first stream byte
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The first byte in a stream MUST have an offset of 0.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Cap delivered stream offset at 2^62-1
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The largest offset delivered on a stream, computed as the sum of the offset and data length, MUST NOT exceed 2^62-1.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Treat oversized stream offsets as connection errors
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A frame that exceeds this limit MUST be treated as a connection error of type FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR or FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Include the Maximum Data field in MAX_DATA frames
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A MAX_DATA frame MUST include a Maximum Data (i) field.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Set the MAX_DATA frame type value
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A MAX_DATA frame MUST encode Type (i) as 0x10.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Encode the Maximum Data field as a varint
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Maximum Data field MUST be a variable-length integer that encodes the connection's byte limit.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Count STREAM data toward connection flow control
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: All data sent in STREAM frames MUST count toward this limit.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Keep total final stream sizes within the advertised limit
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The sum of the final sizes on all streams, including terminal streams, MUST NOT exceed the receiver's advertised limit.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Allow MAX_STREAM_DATA on Recv streams
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A MAX_STREAM_DATA frame MAY be sent for streams in the Recv state.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Encode MAX_STREAM_DATA fields in order
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A MAX_STREAM_DATA frame MUST contain a Stream ID field followed by a Maximum Stream Data field, both encoded as variable-length integers.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Set MAX_STREAM_DATA type to 0x11
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A MAX_STREAM_DATA frame MUST have type 0x11.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Identify the affected stream in MAX_STREAM_DATA
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Stream ID field of a MAX_STREAM_DATA frame MUST identify the affected stream.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define the stream data limit in bytes
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Maximum Stream Data field of a MAX_STREAM_DATA frame MUST indicate the maximum amount of data that can be sent on the identified stream, in units of bytes.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Count the largest received offset toward the stream data limit
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: When counting data toward this limit, an endpoint MUST account for the largest received offset of data that is sent or received on the stream.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: MAX_STREAMS frame cumulative limit
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A MAX_STREAMS frame MUST inform the peer of the cumulative number of streams of a given type it is permitted to open.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: MAX_STREAMS type 0x12 applies to bidirectional streams
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A MAX_STREAMS frame with type 0x12 MUST apply to bidirectional streams.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: MAX_STREAMS type 0x13 applies to unidirectional streams
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A MAX_STREAMS frame with type 0x13 MUST apply to unidirectional streams.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Maximum Streams cumulative lifetime count
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Maximum Streams value MUST be the cumulative number of streams of the corresponding type that can be opened over the lifetime of the connection.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: MAX_STREAMS value limit
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Maximum Streams value MUST NOT exceed 2^60.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR on oversized MAX_STREAMS limit
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST treat receipt of a frame that permits opening a stream larger than 2^60 as a connection error of type FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Ignore non-increasing MAX_STREAMS frames
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A MAX_STREAMS frame that does not increase the stream limit MUST be ignored.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Send DATA_BLOCKED under connection flow control blocking
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A sender SHOULD send a DATA_BLOCKED frame (type=0x14) when it wishes to send data but is unable to do so due to connection-level flow control.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Include Maximum Data field
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A DATA_BLOCKED frame MUST contain a Maximum Data field.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Set the DATA_BLOCKED frame type
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A DATA_BLOCKED frame MUST have type 0x14.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Encode Maximum Data as a varint
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Maximum Data field MUST be a variable-length integer indicating the connection-level limit at which blocking occurred.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use type 0x15 for STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED frame MUST use type 0x15.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Encode STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED Stream ID as a variable-length integer
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED frame MUST include a Stream ID field encoded as a variable-length integer that indicates the stream that is blocked due to flow control.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Encode STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED Maximum Stream Data as a variable-length integer
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED frame MUST include a Maximum Stream Data field encoded as a variable-length integer that indicates the offset of the stream at which the blocking occurred.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Send STREAMS_BLOCKED when stream creation is blocked
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A sender SHOULD send a STREAMS_BLOCKED frame when it wishes to open a stream but cannot do so because its peer's maximum stream limit prevents creation.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use type 0x16 for bidirectional stream limit
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A STREAMS_BLOCKED frame of type 0x16 MUST indicate that the bidirectional stream limit has been reached.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use type 0x17 for unidirectional stream limit
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A STREAMS_BLOCKED frame of type 0x17 MUST indicate that the unidirectional stream limit has been reached.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Include Maximum Streams as variable-length integer
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A STREAMS_BLOCKED frame MUST include a Maximum Streams field encoded as a variable-length integer.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use STREAMS_BLOCKED frame type range 0x16..0x17
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A STREAMS_BLOCKED frame MUST use type 0x16 or 0x17.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Limit STREAMS_BLOCKED value
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Maximum Streams value in a STREAMS_BLOCKED frame MUST NOT exceed 2^60.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Reject oversized STREAMS_BLOCKED stream IDs
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A frame that encodes a larger stream ID MUST be treated as a connection error of type STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR or FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Encode NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame fields in order
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame MUST encode Type (i)=0x18, Sequence Number (i), Retire Prior To (i), Length, Connection ID, and Stateless Reset Token in that order.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Encode NEW_CONNECTION_ID sequence number as varint
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Sequence Number in a NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame MUST be encoded as a variable-length integer.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Encode NEW_CONNECTION_ID retire-prior-to as varint
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Retire Prior To field in a NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame MUST be encoded as a variable-length integer.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Encode NEW_CONNECTION_ID length as 8-bit integer
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Length field in a NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame MUST be an 8-bit unsigned integer containing the length of the connection ID.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Reject invalid NEW_CONNECTION_ID lengths
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A NEW_CONNECTION_ID Length value less than 1 or greater than 20 MUST be treated as a connection error of type FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Size NEW_CONNECTION_ID connection ID by Length
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Connection ID field in a NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame MUST be the length specified by the Length field.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Encode NEW_CONNECTION_ID stateless reset token as 128 bits
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Stateless Reset Token field in a NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame MUST be a 128-bit value.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Request additional connection IDs when retiring
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint that sends a RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frame MUST request the peer to send additional connection IDs for future use.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Invalidate stateless reset tokens when retiring connection IDs
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Retiring a connection ID MUST invalidate the stateless reset token associated with that connection ID.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use frame type 0x19 for RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Type field of a RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frame MUST be 0x19.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Include a Sequence Number field in RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frames
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frames MUST contain a Sequence Number field.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Sequence Number identifies the retired connection ID
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Sequence Number field MUST specify the sequence number of the connection ID being retired.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Send updated ACKs quickly when packets are out of order
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: When packets are received out of order, an updated ACK frame SHOULD be sent quickly.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Fit ACK frames in one packet
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An ACK frame SHOULD fit within a single QUIC packet.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Omit older ACK ranges when needed
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: If an ACK frame does not fit within a single QUIC packet, older ranges (those with the smallest packet numbers) MUST be omitted.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Include acknowledged packet ranges in ACK frames
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An ACK frame MUST include one or more acknowledged packet ranges.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: ACK frames in matching packet number spaces
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: ACK frames MUST be carried only in packets from the same packet number space as the packet being acknowledged.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Reject RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID sequence numbers above peer issuance
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint that receives a RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frame containing a sequence number greater than any it has previously sent to the peer MUST treat it as a connection error of type PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Prohibit RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID on zero-length peer CID
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST NOT send a RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frame if it was provided with a zero-length connection ID by its peer.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: PATH_CHALLENGE Data field length
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A PATH_CHALLENGE frame MUST include a 64-bit Data field.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: PATH_CHALLENGE frame type value
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A PATH_CHALLENGE frame MUST have type 0x1a.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Send new connection IDs in NEW_CONNECTION_ID frames
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: New connection IDs MUST be sent in NEW_CONNECTION_ID frames.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Retransmit new connection IDs when lost
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: New connection IDs MUST be retransmitted if the packet containing them is lost.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Preserve sequence number on retransmission
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Retransmitted NEW_CONNECTION_ID frames MUST carry the same sequence number value.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Send retired connection IDs in RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frames
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Retired connection IDs MUST be sent in RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frames.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Retransmit retired connection IDs when lost
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Retired connection IDs MUST be retransmitted if the packet containing them is lost.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Retransmit NEW_TOKEN frames when lost
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: NEW_TOKEN frames MUST be retransmitted if the packet containing them is lost.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Detect reordered or duplicated NEW_TOKEN frames by direct comparison
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Endpoints MUST detect reordered and duplicated NEW_TOKEN frames by direct comparison of the frame contents.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Prioritize retransmission over new data
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Endpoints SHOULD prioritize retransmission of data over sending new data, unless priorities specified by the application indicate otherwise.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Allow retransmission of frames from lost packets
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A sender MAY retransmit copies of frames from lost packets.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Handle payload size decreases during retransmission
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A sender that retransmits copies of frames MUST handle decreases in available payload size due to changes in packet number length, connection ID length, and path MTU.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: PATH_CHALLENGE Data field contents
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A PATH_CHALLENGE frame MUST include an 8-byte Data field with arbitrary contents.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Respond to PATH_CHALLENGE with PATH_RESPONSE
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The recipient of a PATH_CHALLENGE frame MUST generate a PATH_RESPONSE frame containing the same Data value.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: PATH_RESPONSE frame type value
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A PATH_RESPONSE frame MUST have type 0x1b.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: PATH_RESPONSE frame Data field
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A PATH_RESPONSE frame MUST contain a 64-bit Data field.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: PATH_RESPONSE frame type
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A PATH_RESPONSE frame MUST have type 0x1b.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: PATH_RESPONSE mismatch error handling
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: If the content of a PATH_RESPONSE frame does not match the content of a previously sent PATH_CHALLENGE frame, an endpoint MAY generate a connection error of type PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Signal application errors with type 0x1d CONNECTION_CLOSE
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A CONNECTION_CLOSE frame with a type of 0x1d MUST signal an error with the application that uses QUIC.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Implicitly close open streams on connection close
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Open streams that have not been explicitly closed MUST be implicitly closed when the connection is closed.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: CONNECTION_CLOSE trailing field order
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A CONNECTION_CLOSE frame MUST encode Error Code (i), Reason Phrase Length (i), and Reason Phrase (..) in that order.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: CONNECTION_CLOSE type range
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Type field of a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame MUST be 0x1c..0x1d.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Optional CONNECTION_CLOSE Frame Type field
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A CONNECTION_CLOSE frame MAY include Frame Type (i) between Error Code (i) and Reason Phrase Length (i).

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define CONNECTION_CLOSE error code field
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Error Code field of a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame MUST be a variable-length integer that indicates the reason for closing this connection.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use application error code space for 0x1d
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A CONNECTION_CLOSE frame of type 0x1d MUST use codes defined by the application protocol.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define CONNECTION_CLOSE Frame Type field
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Frame Type field of a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame MUST be a variable-length integer that encodes the type of frame that triggered the error.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use zero for unknown frame types
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A value of 0 MUST be used when the frame type is unknown.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define reason phrase length encoding
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Reason Phrase Length MUST be a variable-length integer specifying the length of the reason phrase in bytes.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Keep CONNECTION_CLOSE frames unsplit
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A CONNECTION_CLOSE frame MUST not be split between packets.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Allow empty reason phrases
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The reason phrase MAY be zero length if the sender chooses not to give details beyond the Error Code value.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Encode the reason phrase as UTF-8
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The reason phrase SHOULD be a UTF-8 encoded string.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Restrict application-specific CONNECTION_CLOSE packet types
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The application-specific variant of CONNECTION_CLOSE (type 0x1d) MUST be sent only using 0-RTT or 1-RTT packets.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Require HANDSHAKE_DONE to have no content
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A HANDSHAKE_DONE frame MUST have no content.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Set the HANDSHAKE_DONE frame type
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The HANDSHAKE_DONE frame type MUST be 0x1e.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Limit HANDSHAKE_DONE to server transmission
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A HANDSHAKE_DONE frame MUST be sent only by the server.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Understand frame syntax before processing packets
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST understand the syntax of all frames before it can successfully process a packet.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Do not send unknown frame types to peers
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST NOT send a frame of a type that is unknown to its peer.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: ACK-replacing extension frames are exempt
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Extension frames that replace or supplement the ACK frame MUST NOT be subject to the congestion-control and ACK-frame-sending requirements in this section.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: QUIC error codes are 62-bit unsigned integers
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: QUIC transport error codes and application error codes MUST be 62-bit unsigned integers.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use NO_ERROR for abrupt closes without error
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST use NO_ERROR with CONNECTION_CLOSE to signal that the connection is being closed abruptly in the absence of any error.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use INTERNAL_ERROR for unrecoverable internal failures
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST use INTERNAL_ERROR when it encounters an internal error and cannot continue with the connection.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use CONNECTION_REFUSED when refusing a new connection
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A server MUST use CONNECTION_REFUSED when it refuses to accept a new connection.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR for advertised data limit violations
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST use FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR when it receives more data than it permitted in its advertised data limits.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR for stream limit violations
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST use STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR when it receives a frame for a stream identifier that exceeds its advertised stream limit for the corresponding stream type.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use STREAM_STATE_ERROR for frames invalid in the stream state
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST use STREAM_STATE_ERROR when it receives a frame for a stream that is not in a state that permits that frame.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use FINAL_SIZE_ERROR when a different final size is established
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST use FINAL_SIZE_ERROR when it receives a STREAM frame or RESET_STREAM frame containing a final size different from the one already established.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use FINAL_SIZE_ERROR when stream data exceeds the final size
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST use FINAL_SIZE_ERROR when it receives a STREAM frame containing data that exceeds the previously established final size.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use FINAL_SIZE_ERROR when the final size is lower than received stream data
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST use FINAL_SIZE_ERROR when it receives a STREAM frame or RESET_STREAM frame containing a final size that is lower than the size of stream data already received.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR for badly formatted frames
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST use FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR when it receives a frame that is badly formatted.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use TRANSPORT_PARAMETER_ERROR for badly formatted transport parameters
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST use TRANSPORT_PARAMETER_ERROR when it receives transport parameters that are badly formatted.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use TRANSPORT_PARAMETER_ERROR for forbidden transport parameters
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST use TRANSPORT_PARAMETER_ERROR when it receives transport parameters that include a forbidden transport parameter.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use TRANSPORT_PARAMETER_ERROR for invalid transport parameter values
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST use TRANSPORT_PARAMETER_ERROR when it receives transport parameters that include an invalid value.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use TRANSPORT_PARAMETER_ERROR for missing mandatory transport parameters
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST use TRANSPORT_PARAMETER_ERROR when it receives transport parameters that omit a mandatory transport parameter.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use TRANSPORT_PARAMETER_ERROR for other transport parameter errors
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST use TRANSPORT_PARAMETER_ERROR when it receives transport parameters that are otherwise in error.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use CONNECTION_ID_LIMIT_ERROR when the peer exceeds active_connection_id_limit
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST use CONNECTION_ID_LIMIT_ERROR when the number of connection IDs provided by the peer exceeds the advertised active_connection_id_limit.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use PROTOCOL_VIOLATION for uncategorized protocol compliance errors
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST use PROTOCOL_VIOLATION when it detects a protocol compliance error that is not covered by a more specific error code.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use INVALID_TOKEN for an invalid client Initial token
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A server MUST use INVALID_TOKEN when it receives a client Initial that contains an invalid Token field.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use APPLICATION_ERROR when the application closes the connection
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST use APPLICATION_ERROR when the application or application protocol causes the connection to be closed.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use CRYPTO_BUFFER_EXCEEDED when CRYPTO data exceeds buffer capacity
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST use CRYPTO_BUFFER_EXCEEDED when it has received more data in CRYPTO frames than it can buffer.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use KEY_UPDATE_ERROR when key updates fail
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST use KEY_UPDATE_ERROR when it detects errors in performing key updates.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use AEAD_LIMIT_REACHED when AEAD limits are reached
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST use AEAD_LIMIT_REACHED when it reaches the confidentiality or integrity limit for the AEAD algorithm used by the connection.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use NO_VIABLE_PATH when the network path cannot support QUIC
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST use NO_VIABLE_PATH when it determines that the network path is incapable of supporting QUIC.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Reserve 256 values for handshake-specific crypto errors
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The transport MUST reserve a range of 256 values for carrying error codes specific to the cryptographic handshake in use.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Assign unique codes to actionable transport errors
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Transport error conditions requiring recipient action MUST be assigned unique codes.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Leave application error code management to application protocols
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Application protocols MUST manage application error codes.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use application error codes for CONNECTION_CLOSE type 0x1d
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Application protocol error codes MUST be used for the CONNECTION_CLOSE frame with a type of 0x1d.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use application error codes for RESET_STREAM
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Application protocol error codes MUST be used for the RESET_STREAM frame.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use application error codes for STOP_SENDING
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Application protocol error codes MUST be used for the STOP_SENDING frame.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Anti-amplification 3x sending limit toward unvalidated address
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST NOT send data toward an unvalidated address in excess of three times the data received from that address.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Apply anti-amplification limit only on unvalidated addresses
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST apply the anti-amplification limit only when responding to packets received from an unvalidated address.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Exclude anti-amplification limit for clients during connection setup and migration
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The anti-amplification limit MUST NOT apply to clients when establishing a new connection or when initiating connection migration.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use Retry to validate the client address before expensive computation
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Retry packet MUST provide a token exchange mechanism that lets servers validate a client's IP address before expensive computations.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Allow servers to issue new tokens after a successful handshake
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: After a successful handshake, servers MAY issue new tokens to a client so new connection establishment does not incur this cost.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Limit on-path handshake failure to packet dropping
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Once valid Initial packets have been exchanged, an on-path attacker MUST NOT be able to force handshake failure except by dropping packets and causing endpoints to abandon the attempt.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Protect Handshake packets after valid Initial exchange
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Once valid Initial packets have been exchanged, subsequent Handshake packets MUST be protected with the Handshake keys.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use the quoted packet to associate ICMP messages
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: This validation SHOULD use the quoted packet supplied in the payload of an ICMP message to associate the message with a corresponding transport connection (see Section 4.6.1 of [DPLPMTUD]).

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Match IP addresses and UDP ports in ICMP validation
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: ICMP message validation MUST include matching IP addresses and UDP ports [RFC8085].

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Associate ICMP messages with an active QUIC session when possible
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: ICMP message validation MUST include connection IDs to an active QUIC session when possible.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Do not increase PMTU based on ICMP messages
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST NOT increase the PMTU based on ICMP messages; see Item 6 in Section 3 of [DPLPMTUD].

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Encrypt Handshake and later packets with TLS-derived keys
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Handshake and later packets MUST be encrypted with keys derived from the TLS key exchange.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Encrypt Initial packets with per-version keys
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Initial packets MUST be encrypted with per-version keys.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Fold parameter negotiation into the TLS transcript
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Parameter negotiation MUST be folded into the TLS transcript.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Integrity-protect connection IDs in all packets
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Connection IDs MUST be integrity protected in all packets.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Keep connection IDs unencrypted
