staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Connection IDs MUST be unencrypted.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Fail incompatible-version connections
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Implementations of incompatible QUIC versions MUST fail to establish a connection.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Apply authenticated encryption to protected packets
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Packet protection MUST apply authenticated encryption to all packets except Version Negotiation packets.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Limit protection for Initial and Retry packets
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Initial and Retry packets MUST use version-specific keying material for packet protection.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Ignore invalid packets after handshake completion
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Endpoints that completed the handshake MUST ignore invalid packets.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Restrict payload processing to handshake-complete endpoints
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Packet payloads MUST only be processed by endpoints that completed the handshake.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use one migration path at a time
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Endpoints using connection migration MUST use one path at a time for transmission and receipt of non-probing frames.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Establish peer willingness and ability for a path
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Path validation MUST establish that a peer is both willing and able to receive packets sent on a particular path.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Drop packets with modified authenticated portions
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A receiving endpoint MUST drop any packet whose authenticated portion is modified.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Keep stateless reset tokens secret until used
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A stateless reset token MUST be kept secret until it is used.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Discard packets on different paths during the handshake
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MAY discard packets received on a different network path during the handshake.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Match connection IDs to the peer
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Source and Destination Connection ID fields MUST match those set by a peer.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Accept only packets with locally chosen DCIDs
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Except for Initial and Stateless Resets, an endpoint MUST only accept packets that include a Destination Connection ID field that matches a value the endpoint previously chose.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Choose unpredictable Initial DCIDs
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A client MUST select the Destination Connection ID field in an Initial packet to be unpredictable.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Protect handshake packets with derived keys
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Packets that carry the cryptographic handshake MUST be protected with a key derived from this connection ID and a salt specific to the QUIC version.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Permit other handshake interference recovery methods
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Endpoints MAY use other methods to detect and attempt to recover from interference with the handshake.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Limit address validation token usage and lifetime
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Servers SHOULD limit the usage and lifetime of address validation tokens.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Skip packet numbers to detect optimistic ACK behavior
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MAY skip packet numbers when sending packets.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Close on optimistic ACK detection
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MAY immediately close the connection with PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Avoid deployment in unsafe ingress-filtering networks
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: QUIC servers SHOULD NOT be deployed in networks that do not deploy ingress filtering and also have inadequately secured UDP endpoints.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Servers MUST NOT migrate in this version
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: This version of QUIC MUST NOT allow server migration.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Prevent non-QUIC packets to unwilling destinations
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: For a new connection, the implicit handshake address validation MUST ensure that a client will not send other types of packets to a destination that does not understand QUIC or is not willing to accept a QUIC connection.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Choose unpredictable Destination Connection IDs
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A client SHOULD choose an unpredictable Destination Connection ID so servers cannot control the encrypted portion of Initial packets.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Choose Not To Use NEW_TOKEN
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A client MAY choose not to use the NEW_TOKEN frame.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Send Empty Token After Address Change
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A client SHOULD send an empty Token field when the server address has changed since the NEW_TOKEN frame was received.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Change Token Field In Retry
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A server MAY change the Token field when sending a Retry packet.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Control Destination Connection ID After Retry
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: After sending a Retry, a server MAY control the Destination Connection ID field of subsequent client Initial packets.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Validate Server Address With Retry Exchange
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A Retry exchange MUST validate the server's address and prevent subsequent Initial packets from being used for request forgery.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Migrate To Preferred Address After Handshake
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A client MUST migrate to a preferred address after confirming the handshake.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Specify Preferred Address
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A server MAY specify a preferred address.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Do not send non-probing frames to a preferred address before validation
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A client MUST NOT send non-probing frames to a preferred address before validating that address.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Keep the first byte of a Version Negotiation packet outside client control
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The first byte of a Version Negotiation packet MUST NOT be under client control.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Limit client control of Version Negotiation packets to 512 bytes from the fifth byte
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A Version Negotiation packet MUST allow the client to control up to 512 bytes starting from the fifth byte.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Zero the next four bytes of a Version Negotiation packet
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The next four bytes of a Version Negotiation packet MUST be zero.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use optional request-forgery countermeasures before address validation
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Endpoints MAY reduce the risk of request forgery by not including values from NEW_TOKEN frames in Initial packets or by only sending probing frames in packets prior to completing address validation.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Avoid sending datagrams to problematic ports or patterns before validation
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Endpoints MAY avoid sending datagrams to these ports or datagrams that match these patterns prior to validating the destination address.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Provide Slowloris mitigations
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: QUIC deployments SHOULD provide mitigations for Slowloris attacks.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Align flow control windows with available memory
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Flow control windows SHOULD correspond to available memory.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Open intervening streams for higher stream IDs
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A receiver MUST open all intervening streams of the same type when it receives a higher-numbered stream ID.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Limit active streams with transport parameters
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The number of active streams MUST be limited by the initial_max_streams_bidi and initial_max_streams_uni transport parameters as updated by any received MAX_STREAMS frames.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Track processing cost relative to progress
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Implementations SHOULD track processing cost relative to progress.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Treat excessive non-productive packets as attacks
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Implementations SHOULD treat excessive quantities of any non-productive packets as indicative of an attack.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Endpoints may respond with a connection error or drop packets
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Endpoints MAY respond with a connection error or drop packets.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Ignore the ECN field unless a QUIC packet is processed
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: QUIC endpoints MUST ignore the ECN field in an IP packet unless at least one QUIC packet in that IP packet is successfully processed.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Route packets to a stateful instance when sharing a static reset key
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Endpoints that share a static key for stateless resets MUST route packets with a given connection ID to an instance with connection state unless that connection is no longer active.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Require codepoint value and contact information for provisional registrations
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Provisional registrations MUST include the codepoint value and contact information.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Require Expert Review for provisional registrations
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Provisional registrations MUST require Expert Review, as defined in Section 4.5 of RFC 8126.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Include Date field in provisional registrations
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Provisional registrations MUST include a Date field.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Allow Date updates without expert review
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Updating the Date field on a provisional registration MUST NOT require designated expert review.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Do not require Date when requesting registrations
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Date field MUST NOT be required when requesting a registration.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Prefer randomly selected registry codepoints
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: New requests for codepoints from QUIC registries SHOULD use a randomly selected codepoint that excludes existing allocations and the first unallocated codepoint in the selected space.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Reserve first unassigned codepoint for Standards Action
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The first unassigned codepoint MUST be reserved for allocation using the Standards Action policy.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Prefer short variable-length integer encodings for codepoints
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: For codepoints encoded as variable-length integers, codepoints that encode to four or eight bytes (values 2^14 and above) SHOULD be used unless the usage is especially sensitive to a longer encoding.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Allocate selected unassigned codepoints when policy requirements are met
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: IANA MUST allocate the selected codepoint if it is unassigned and the registration policy requirements are met.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Do not reclaim recently updated entries
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Entries that have been updated less than a year prior SHOULD NOT be reclaimed.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Limit reclamation to earliest recorded dates
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Requests to reclaim provisional codepoints SHOULD be limited to codepoints with the earliest recorded date.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Apply review and consultation to provisional-to-permanent changes
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Requests to change a provisional registration into a permanent registration MUST use the same review and consultation process.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Confirm deployed usage for permanent registration changes
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: For requests to change a provisional registration into a permanent registration, the process MUST determine that the registration accurately represents any deployed usage.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Allow additional constraints on permanent registrations
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A registry MAY specify additional constraints on permanent registrations.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Allow different registration policies for codepoint ranges
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A registry MAY identify a codepoint range governed by a different registration policy.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Do not block provisional registrations
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Stricter requirements for permanent registrations MUST NOT prevent provisional registrations for affected codepoints.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Assign permanent status to registrations in this document
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: All registrations in this document MUST have permanent status.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: List the change controller and contact for registrations in this document
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: All registrations in this document MUST list the IETF as the change controller and the QUIC Working Group (quic@ietf.org) as the contact.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Limit QUIC Versions registry to 32 bits
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The "QUIC Versions" registry MUST govern a 32-bit space.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Apply the Section 22.1 registration policy
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The "QUIC Versions" registry MUST follow the registration policy from Section 22.1.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use Specification Required for permanent QUIC Versions registrations
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Permanent registrations in the "QUIC Versions" registry MUST use the Specification Required policy (RFC 8126 Section 4.6).

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Assign 0x00000001 permanent status
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The codepoint of 0x00000001 MUST be assigned permanent status for the protocol defined in this document.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Exclude 0x?a?a?a?a values from assigned listings
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Codepoints that follow the pattern 0x?a?a?a?a MUST NOT appear in the listing of assigned values.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Reserve 0x?a?a?a?a values from assignment
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Codepoints that follow the pattern 0x?a?a?a?a MUST NOT be assigned by IANA.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Limit QUIC Transport Parameters registry to 62 bits
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The "QUIC Transport Parameters" registry MUST govern a 62-bit space.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Assign 0x00 to original_destination_connection_id
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The QUIC Transport Parameters registry MUST assign 0x00 to original_destination_connection_id.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Assign 0x01 to max_idle_timeout
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The QUIC Transport Parameters registry MUST assign 0x01 to max_idle_timeout.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Assign 0x02 to stateless_reset_token
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The QUIC Transport Parameters registry MUST assign 0x02 to stateless_reset_token.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Assign 0x03 to max_udp_payload_size
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The QUIC Transport Parameters registry MUST assign 0x03 to max_udp_payload_size.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Assign 0x04 to initial_max_data
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The QUIC Transport Parameters registry MUST assign 0x04 to initial_max_data.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Assign 0x05 to initial_max_stream_data_bidi_local
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The QUIC Transport Parameters registry MUST assign 0x05 to initial_max_stream_data_bidi_local.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Assign 0x06 to initial_max_stream_data_bidi_remote
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The QUIC Transport Parameters registry MUST assign 0x06 to initial_max_stream_data_bidi_remote.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Assign 0x07 to initial_max_stream_data_uni
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The QUIC Transport Parameters registry MUST assign 0x07 to initial_max_stream_data_uni.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Assign 0x08 to initial_max_streams_bidi
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The QUIC Transport Parameters registry MUST assign 0x08 to initial_max_streams_bidi.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Assign 0x09 to initial_max_streams_uni
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The QUIC Transport Parameters registry MUST assign 0x09 to initial_max_streams_uni.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Assign 0x0a to ack_delay_exponent
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The QUIC Transport Parameters registry MUST assign 0x0a to ack_delay_exponent.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Assign 0x0b to max_ack_delay
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The QUIC Transport Parameters registry MUST assign 0x0b to max_ack_delay.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Assign 0x0c to disable_active_migration
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The QUIC Transport Parameters registry MUST assign 0x0c to disable_active_migration.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Assign 0x0d to preferred_address
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The QUIC Transport Parameters registry MUST assign 0x0d to preferred_address.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Assign 0x0e to active_connection_id_limit
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The QUIC Transport Parameters registry MUST assign 0x0e to active_connection_id_limit.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Assign 0x0f to initial_source_connection_id
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The QUIC Transport Parameters registry MUST assign 0x0f to initial_source_connection_id.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Assign 0x10 to retry_source_connection_id
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The QUIC Transport Parameters registry MUST assign 0x10 to retry_source_connection_id.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Exclude 31*N+27 values from assigned listings
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Values of the form 31 * N + 27 MUST NOT appear in the listing of assigned values.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Reserve 31*N+27 values from assignment
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Values of the form 31 * N + 27 MUST NOT be assigned by IANA.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Describe when a frame type can be sent
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Specifications for new permanent registrations SHOULD describe how an endpoint can determine it can send the frame type.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Allow Description to be a summary
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Description field MAY be a summary if a specification reference is provided.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: ReadVarint accepts byte-sequence input
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The ReadVarint function MUST take a single argument consisting of a sequence of bytes that can be read in network byte order.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: ReadVarint derives length from the first-byte prefix
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The decoder MUST derive the variable-length integer length from the first two bits of the first byte.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: ReadVarint clears prefix bits and reads remaining bytes
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: After the length is known, the decoder MUST clear those bits, read the remaining length-1 bytes, and build the value by left-shifting 8 bits and adding each next byte.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Compute num_unacked from the latest acknowledgment
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Otherwise, num_unacked MUST be full_pn - largest_acked.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Compute num_unacked with no prior acknowledgment
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: When largest_acked is None, num_unacked MUST be full_pn + 1.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Require one extra bit beyond log2 of unacknowledged packets
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The number of bits MUST be at least one more than the base-2 logarithm of num_unacked.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Compute the minimum bit count
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The minimum bit count MUST be log(num_unacked, 2) + 1.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Round the bit count up to bytes
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The byte count MUST be ceil(min_bits / 8).

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Compute packet number decode variables
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The decoder MUST compute expected_pn as largest_pn + 1, pn_win as 1 << pn_nbits, pn_hwin as pn_win / 2, pn_mask as pn_win - 1, and candidate_pn as (expected_pn & ~pn_mask) | truncated_pn.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Return the higher window candidate
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: If candidate_pn <= expected_pn - pn_hwin and candidate_pn < (1 << 62) - pn_win, the decoder MUST return candidate_pn + pn_win.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Return the in-window candidate
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Otherwise, the decoder MUST return candidate_pn.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Return the lower window candidate
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: If candidate_pn > expected_pn + pn_hwin and candidate_pn >= pn_win, the decoder MUST return candidate_pn - pn_win.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Check ECN support on new paths
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Before sending on a new network path, an endpoint MUST determine whether the path supports ECN.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Periodically reassess unsupported ECN paths
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MAY periodically reassess a path previously determined not to support ECN.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Limit ECN state values
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A path's ECN state MUST be one of `testing`, `unknown`, `failed`, or `capable`.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Send ECT-marked packets on testing or capable paths
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: On a `testing` or `capable` path, the endpoint MUST send packets with an ECT marking, defaulting to ECT(0).

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Send unmarked packets on other paths
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: On any other path, the endpoint MUST send unmarked packets.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Mark a path testing when ECN validation starts
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: To start testing a path, the ECN state MUST be set to `testing`.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Remember ECN counts before testing
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: To start testing a path, existing ECN counts MUST be remembered as a baseline.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Transition testing paths to unknown
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: After the testing period ends, the path's ECN state MUST become `unknown`.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Transition unknown ECN state to capable after successful validation
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: If the path ECN state is `unknown` and ECN-count validation in an ACK frame succeeds, the path's ECN state MUST become `capable`, unless no marked packet has been acknowledged.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Mark ECN state failed when validation fails
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: If validation of the ECN counts fails at any time, the ECN state for the affected path MUST become "failed".

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Allow marking ECN state failed for lost or CE-marked packets
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MAY mark the ECN state for a path as "failed" if marked packets are all declared lost or if they are all ECN-CE marked.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Disable ECN when markings are modified incorrectly
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: If a path incorrectly modifies markings, ECN MUST be disabled for that path.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Type-specific packet payload
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The remainder of the packet, if any, MUST be type specific.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Initial packet type value
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Initial packet type MUST be encoded as 0x00.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: 0-RTT packet type value
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The 0-RTT packet type MUST be encoded as 0x01.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Handshake packet type value
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Handshake packet type MUST be encoded as 0x02.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Retry packet type value
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The Retry packet type MUST be encoded as 0x03.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Version-independent long-header fields
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The header form bit, Destination and Source Connection ID lengths, Destination and Source Connection ID fields, and Version fields of a long header packet MUST be version independent.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Version-specific first-byte fields
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The other fields in the first byte MUST be version specific.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Version- and packet-type-specific interpretation
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The interpretation of the fields and the payload MUST be specific to a version and packet type.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Reserved first-byte bits
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Two bits of byte 0 with a mask of 0x0c MUST be reserved across multiple packet types.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Protect reserved bits with header protection
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: These bits MUST be protected using header protection.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Zero the pre-protection value
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The value included prior to protection MUST be set to 0.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use a separate Handshake packet number space
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Handshake packets MUST have their own packet number space.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Start server Handshake packet numbers at zero
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The first Handshake packet sent by a server MUST contain a packet number of 0.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Require CRYPTO frames in Handshake payloads
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The payload of a Handshake packet MUST contain CRYPTO frames.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Allow PING, PADDING, or ACK frames in Handshake payloads
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The payload of a Handshake packet MAY contain PING, PADDING, or ACK frames.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Count handshake, preferred_address, and NEW_CONNECTION_ID connection IDs
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The active_connection_id_limit count MUST include the connection ID received during the handshake, the connection ID received in the preferred_address transport parameter, and the connection IDs received in NEW_CONNECTION_ID frames.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Default active_connection_id_limit to 2 when absent
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: If the active_connection_id_limit transport parameter is absent, an endpoint MUST assume a default of 2.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Ignore peer active_connection_id_limit when using zero-length connection IDs
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: If an endpoint issues a zero-length connection ID, it MUST ignore the active_connection_id_limit value received from its peer.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Bind initial_source_connection_id to first Initial packet
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST set initial_source_connection_id to the value it included in the Source Connection ID field of the first Initial packet it sends for the connection.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Bind retry_source_connection_id to Retry packet
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A server MUST set retry_source_connection_id to the value it included in the Source Connection ID field of a Retry packet.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Restrict retry_source_connection_id to servers
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The retry_source_connection_id transport parameter MUST be sent only by a server.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Ignore duplicate NEW_CONNECTION_ID frames as connection errors
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Receipt of the same NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame multiple times MUST not be treated as a connection error.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: PATH_RESPONSE frame format
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A PATH_RESPONSE frame MUST have the same format as a PATH_CHALLENGE frame.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: CONNECTION_CLOSE type 0x1c error scope
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A CONNECTION_CLOSE frame with type 0x1c MUST signal only QUIC-layer errors or the absence of errors with the NO_ERROR code.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Compute ACK range largest packet number
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The largest packet number value MUST equal previous_smallest - gap - 2.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Reject negative computed packet numbers
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: An endpoint MUST generate a connection error of type FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR if any computed packet number is negative.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use ACK type 0x03 for ECN feedback
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: ACK frame type 0x03 MUST use its least significant bit to indicate ECN feedback for QUIC packets marked ECT(0), ECT(1), or ECN-CE.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Gate ECN counts on ACK type 0x03
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: ECN counts MUST be present only when the ACK frame type is 0x03.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Include all ECN count fields
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: When ECN counts are present, the ACK frame MUST include ECT0 Count, ECT1 Count, and ECN-CE Count fields.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define ECT0 Count field
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The ECT0 Count MUST be a variable-length integer giving the total number of packets received with ECT(0) in the ACK frame's packet number space.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define ECT1 Count field
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The ECT1 Count MUST be a variable-length integer giving the total number of packets received with ECT(1) in the ACK frame's packet number space.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Define ECN-CE Count field
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The ECN-CE Count MUST be a variable-length integer giving the total number of packets received with ECN-CE in the ACK frame's packet number space.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Track ECN counts per packet number space
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: ECN counts MUST be maintained separately for each packet number space.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Terminate after routing changes
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A connection MUST be terminated when a routing change causes a stateless reset, even if an instance still retains connection state.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Prefer stateless reset over timeout
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: When there is no chance of routing a packet to the correct instance, a deployment SHOULD send a stateless reset rather than wait for timeout.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Limit instance targeting
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Deployments SHOULD limit an attacker's ability to target a new connection to a particular server instance.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Allow reserved versions in ignored version fields
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Endpoints MAY add reserved versions to fields where unsupported versions are ignored, to test peer handling.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Send reserved-version packets for discard testing
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Endpoints MAY send packets with a reserved version to test peer discard behavior.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Transmit handshake data in CRYPTO frames
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: QUIC MUST use the CRYPTO frame to transmit the cryptographic handshake.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Identify QUIC version 0x00000001
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The version of QUIC defined in this document MUST be identified as 0x00000001.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Use TLS for the QUIC handshake
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The version of QUIC defined in this document MUST use TLS as described in [QUIC-TLS].

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Provide reliable ordered delivery of handshake data
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: QUIC MUST provide reliable, ordered delivery of the cryptographic handshake data.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Include transport parameters in the handshake
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The encoded transport parameters MUST be included in the cryptographic handshake.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Peer transport parameters available after handshake
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: The transport parameters declared by the peer MUST be available once the handshake completes.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Allow any token in any connection attempt
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: Any token MAY be used in any connection attempt.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Prefer the most recent unused token
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: A client SHOULD send the most recent unused token.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Validate address validation tokens in Initial packets
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: When a server receives an Initial packet with an address validation token, it MUST attempt to validate the token unless it has already completed address validation.

staged_ids_not_in_live.title: Treat invalid tokens as unvalidated addresses
staged_ids_not_in_live.statement: If the token is invalid, the server SHOULD proceed as if the client did not have a validated address, including potentially sending a Retry packet.
